examDates.status: Official exam window per NTA Academic Calendar. Shift-wise date sheet to be published by NTA.

sections.name: Section IA & IB: Languages
sections.description: Reading Comprehension (Factual, Narrative, Literary), Verbal Ability, Vocabulary, and Para Jumbles across 13 Indian + 20 foreign languages.

sections.name: Section II: 27 Domain Specific Subjects
sections.description: Strictly Class 12 Rationalized NCERT curriculum. Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, Accountancy, Business Studies, Economics, History, Political Science, etc.

sections.name: Section III: General Test (GT)
sections.description: General Knowledge, Current Affairs, General Mental Ability, Numerical Ability, and Logical Reasoning for cross-disciplinary admissions.

officialNotice.headline: 50 Compulsory Questions Format with Zero Internal Choice
officialNotice.summary: Every domain subject paper consists of 50 compulsory questions strictly based on rationalized Class 12 NCERT curriculum with +5 / -1 marking scheme.

eligibility.ageLimit: No upper age limit for appearing in CUET UG.
eligibility.qualifyingExam: Candidates who have passed Class 12 (or equivalent) in 2024, 2025, or are appearing in 2026 are eligible.
eligibility.universityMapping: Candidates must satisfy individual university eligibility criteria (e.g. University of Delhi mandates appearing in CUET in subjects studied in Class 12).

registrationSteps.title: NTA Online Registration
registrationSteps.description: Register on official portal exams.nta.ac.in/CUET-UG. Enter personal details and generate application number and password.

registrationSteps.title: Subject & University Mapping
registrationSteps.description: Select participating central universities (DU, BHU, JNU) and choose up to 6 domain and language tests matching degree prerequisites.

registrationSteps.title: Document Upload & Fee Payment
registrationSteps.description: Upload scanned photo, signature, Class 10/12 marksheets, and category certificates (OBC-NCL/EWS/SC/ST). Pay application fee.

registrationSteps.title: City Slip & Hall Ticket
registrationSteps.description: Download Advance Examination City Slip followed by official NTA CBT Admit Card containing shift timings and test center.
